prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single, objective “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your organization’s size, specialty, goals, budget and the services you need. I can help you find the best fit. To get you started, here are practical criteria and next steps so you can identify a strong agency quickly.

What “best” usually means (key criteria)
- Healthcare experience: proven work with hospitals, medical groups, clinics or specialty practices.  
- Measurable results: patient acquisition, lead conversion, referral growth, improved reputation scores, ROI.  
- Services you need: SEO, paid search + social ads, content/PR, brand/creative, physician recruitment, email/CRM, telehealth support, HIPAA-compliant tracking.  
- Data & analytics: clear reporting and KPI tracking tied to business goals.  
- Compliance expertise: HIPAA, state privacy rules, healthcare advertising restrictions.  
- Client references and case studies: preferably local or regional healthcare clients.  
- Team fit and responsiveness: a single point of contact and alignment on strategy and timeline.  
- Budget and contract flexibility: transparent pricing and scope definitions.

How to evaluate agencies quickly
- Look at recent case studies and ask for specific metrics (e.g., % increase in new patients, cost per acquisition, appointment fill rates).  
- Ask for references from current healthcare clients and call them.  
- Confirm they have HIPAA-compliant processes for handling PHI and tracking.  
- Request a 60–90 day pilot or a clear performance-based deliverable.  
- Check third‑party listings/reviews (Clutch, Google, LinkedIn) and local awards (St. Louis Business Journal, AMA chapters).

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- Have you worked with organizations like ours (size, specialty, payer mix)? Can you share results?  
- How do you measure success for patient acquisition and retention? Which KPIs will you report?  
- How do you handle HIPAA and protected data?  
- What does onboarding look like and who will be our day-to-day contact?  
- Typical timeline to see results for SEO, paid search and content?  
- Example budgets for a 6–12 month plan.

Typical service + budget ranges (rough)
- Local SEO + reputation management: $1k–$4k/month.  
- Paid search/social for patient acquisition: $2k–$15k+/month (ad spend + management).  
- Full-service digital + creative + analytics: $5k–$30k+/month depending on scale.  
(Prices vary widely; get written estimates.)

If you want, I can:
- Research and deliver a short, curated list of 3–5 St. Louis healthcare-focused agencies with pros/cons, sample case-study highlights and contact info.  
- Draft an RFP template or 10-question checklist you can send to agencies.

Which would you prefer? Also tell me: what type of healthcare organization are you (hospital system, multi-site clinic, solo practice, dental, specialty), your approximate monthly budget, and the top 2 outcomes you want (new patients, higher retention, brand awareness, etc.).
